items.title: 用 after + 名词短语表达事件之后
items.explanation: 表示“午饭后、短暂休息后”时，自然表达是 after lunch、after a short rest 或 after a short break；after lunching 很少这样说，after short resting 也不自然。
items.source: After lunching, we proceeded to visit the factory. / After short resting, she continue on performing.
items.example: After a short rest, she continued with her presentation.

items.title: application 与 applicant 的混淆
items.explanation: application 是“申请、申请表、申请材料”；applicant 是“申请人”。当主语是正在被审查的申请时，应说 My application is still under review.
items.source: My applicant is still under review.
items.example: My application is still under review.

items.title: 用 arrive from 表示出发地
items.explanation: arrive from + 地点表示“从某地抵达”；arrive in + 大地点表示“抵达某地”。表达从波士顿来应使用 arrived from Boston。
items.source: They welcome the traveler who had just arrived in Boston.
items.example: They welcomed the traveler who had just arrived from Boston.

items.title: 具体事件和地点名词前的冠词
items.explanation: 提到双方都明确的具体会议、实验室、办公室等可数名词时，通常需要冠词或限定词，例如 after the meeting、visit the lab。缺少冠词会显得不完整或像泛指。
items.source: After meeting, we continued to visit lab.
items.example: After the meeting, we continued to visit the lab.

items.title: back east 的地域方向误用
items.explanation: back east 通常指美国东部，不能用来描述从纽约前往位于美国西部的洛杉矶；该语境应使用 travel west 或直接说 travel to Los Angeles。
items.source: She lives in New York and travels to Los Angeles back east every summer.
items.example: She lives in New York and travels west to Los Angeles every summer.

items.title: but 后并列分句需要谓语动词
items.explanation: but 连接两个完整分句时，后半句需要有限谓语；不能只写 but living，应写 but they later settled 或 but now live。
items.source: My grandparent comes from back east, but living in ...
items.example: My grandparents came from back east, but they later settled in Arizona.

items.title: 避免 continue on ahead 的方向含义重复
items.explanation: continue on 已含有继续向前的意味，通常不再接 ahead；根据语境使用 continue on 或 continue ahead。
items.source: We could continue on ahead after green light.
items.example: When the light turns green, we can continue on.

items.title: continue with 后接名词
items.explanation: 表示继续某项活动、流程或内容时，可使用 continue with + 名词，如 continue with the presentation；continue on performing 不符合本句要求。
items.source: After short resting, she continue on performing.
items.example: After a short rest, she continued with her presentation.

items.title: 直接问句语序与 look at 介词保留
items.explanation: 直接问句要使用疑问词加助动词或 be 动词前置，如 When is she free?；表达“可以看的照片”时，look at 的介词 at 不能省略。
items.source: When she is free and if she has old pictures to look.
items.example: When is she free, and does she have any old photos I could look at?

items.title: 用 for the first time 表示第一次做某事
items.explanation: 表示某次经历是第一次时，常把 for the first time 放在动作或句子的后部；if you first speak 容易被理解为“如果你先讲话”。
items.source: You may feels nervous if you first speak publicly.
items.example: You may feel nervous if you speak in public for the first time.

items.title: 以前住在某地要用过去表达
items.explanation: 中文“以前/过去住在某地”强调过去状态，英语通常用 lived in 或 used to live in；不要用一般现在时 live in 表示过去居住。
items.source: My parents live in New York, but now they live in Los Angeles.
items.example: My parents used to live in New York, but now they live in Los Angeles.

items.title: hear + 宾格 + 动词原形
items.explanation: hear 后面接人作宾语时要用宾格形式，再接动词原形表示听到某人做某事；应说 hear her talk，不说 hear she talk。
items.source: That's great. I want to hear she talk about the main street in the past.
items.example: That's great. I'd like to hear her talk about what Main Street was like in the past.

items.title: history of a place 的介词搭配
items.explanation: 表达“某地的历史”时，英语通常说 the history of the town/place，而不是 the history about the town；about 更像“关于……的内容”，of 更自然地表示所属关系。
items.source: I have just moved here and want to know the history about the town.
items.example: I've just moved here, and I'd like to learn about the history of the town.

items.title: 了解某地历史的自然表达
items.explanation: “了解某地的历史”使用 learn about the history of a place 或 learn about the place’s history，不能说 get the history this city。
items.source: follow guide to get the history this city
items.example: They followed the guide to learn about the city's history.

items.title: 洛杉矶的英文地名表达
items.explanation: 中文地名“洛杉矶”在英语中应使用标准英文名 Los Angeles，不能按汉语拼音写成 luoshanji；专有名词的两个单词都要大写。
items.source: She works in luoshanji, but she visits her parents back east every year.
items.example: She works in Los Angeles, but she visits her parents back east every year.

items.title: located 作表语时不要漏掉 be 动词
items.explanation: located 是过去分词；表示某地或某机构位于某处时，通常使用 be located in/at，不能直接写主语加 located。
items.source: The company's headquarters located in Chicago, but it has several offices back east.
items.example: The company's headquarters is located in Chicago.

items.title: 误把 go out with someone 理解为字面外出
items.explanation: 在恋爱或嫉妒等语境中，go out with someone 通常表示和某人约会或谈恋爱，不能按字面理解为和某人出去或从某处出去。
items.source: 1. A; 2. 不是，表示从她办公室出去了
items.example: Tom got jealous because Lisa was going out with someone from her office.

items.title: 情态动词后使用动词原形
items.explanation: may、can、must 等情态动词后接动词原形；主语是 you 或 he/she 也不能把 feel 写成 feels。
items.source: You may feels nervous if you first speak publicly.
items.example: You may feel nervous if you speak in public for the first time.

items.title: 过去叙事中的时态不一致
items.explanation: 同一段已发生的连续事件应保持一般过去时；前句使用 read 表示过去时后，后句应使用 turned 和 followed。
items.source: After entering exhibit, they close their phone and follow guide
items.example: After entering the exhibition hall, they turned off their phones and followed the guide.

items.title: 完整被动语态需要 be 动词
items.explanation: 从句中 information 是 confirm 的承受者，因此完整被动语态应为 is confirmed；不能省略助动词 is。
items.source: We will continue on your applications after all information confirmed.
items.example: We will proceed with your application after all the information is confirmed.

items.title: 过去叙事中的主句使用过去时
items.explanation: 叙述已经发生的欢迎动作时，主句谓语应使用一般过去时 welcomed，而不是一般现在时 welcome。
items.source: They welcome the traveler who had just arrived in Boston.
items.example: They welcomed the traveler who had just arrived from Boston.

items.title: 过去完成时使用过去分词
items.explanation: 过去完成时结构是 had + 过去分词；fly 的过去式是 flew，过去分词是 flown，因此应说 had flown。
items.source: She was nervous because she had never flew on a plane before that trip.
items.example: She was nervous because she had never flown on a plane before that trip.

items.title: grandparents 的复数对应
items.explanation: 中文“祖父母”通常对应复数 grandparents；描述两位祖辈时不能使用单数 grandparent。
items.source: My grandparent comes from back east, but living in ...
items.example: My grandparents came from back east.

items.title: 用 presentation 表示演示或汇报
items.explanation: presentation 是“演示、汇报”的名词；performing 表示表演或执行动作，不能直接替代 presentation。
items.source: After short resting, she continue on performing.
items.example: After a short rest, she continued with her presentation.

items.title: proceed to 后接动词原形
items.explanation: 表示“接着做下一件事”时使用 proceed to + 动词原形，不能直接把动词接在 proceed 后面。
items.source: Once your name is called, please proceed enter the interview room.
items.example: Once your name is called, please proceed to enter the interview room.

items.title: proceed with 后接事情或流程
items.explanation: 表示继续办理某件事情或执行某项计划时，使用 proceed with + 名词，如 proceed with your application。
items.source: We will continue on your applications after all information confirmed.
items.example: We will proceed with your application after all the information is confirmed.

items.title: 用定语从句或现在分词修饰 friend
items.explanation: 修饰 a friend 时，不能直接说 a friend lived near；应使用定语从句 a friend who lives nearby，或现在分词短语 a friend living nearby。
items.source: I am waiting for a friend lived near.
items.example: I am waiting for a friend who lives nearby.

items.title: old-timers 与 newcomer 语义冲突
items.explanation: old-timers 指长期生活在某地、熟悉当地往事的人，不能和 moved here last week / know nothing about the town 这类新来且不了解当地的描述搭配；这种语境应改用 newcomers 或 new residents。
items.source: Many old-timers moved here last week and know nothing about the town.
items.example: Many newcomers moved here last week and know nothing about the town.

items.title: several 后接可数名词复数
items.explanation: several 表示“几个”，后面接可数名词复数；因此应说 several offices，而不是 several office。
items.source: The company has several office in the east, but the head is in Chigaco.
items.example: The company has several offices in the East.

items.title: 单数可数名词前遗漏限定词
items.explanation: museum、guide 等单数可数名词通常不能裸用，需要根据语境添加 a、the 或其他限定词。
items.source: Students carefully read safety requirements before visiting museum. After entering exhibit, they close their phone and follow guide to get the history this city.
items.example: Before visiting the museum, the students read the safety instructions.

items.title: 用时间从句表达交通灯变色
items.explanation: 表达“绿灯亮后”时，通常说 when/after the light turns green，而不是 after green light；light 前需要限定词，并用 turns green 表达状态变化。
items.source: We could continue on ahead after green light.
items.example: When the light turns green, we can continue on.

items.title: 关闭电子设备应使用 turn off
items.explanation: 表示关闭手机等电子设备通常使用 turn off，而不是 close；多人各自的手机通常用复数 their phones。
items.source: they close their phone
items.example: They turned off their phones before the tour began.

items.title: when 从句描述开业事件的动词和时态
items.explanation: 表达“某地刚开业的时候”应使用 opened 或 had just opened，而不是 close；在 remember when... 中，when 从句通常用过去时或过去完成时来描述被回忆的过去事件。
items.source: Many old-timers still remember when the theatre just close.
items.example: Many old-timers still remember when the theater had just opened.
